role.zh: TypeSafe AI 联合创始人兼 CEO

why.en: Co-author of InstructGPT, the work that turned RLHF into the alignment method behind ChatGPT and, with it, the shape of every assistant model since. Left OpenAI in 2024 and came out of stealth in September 2026 with TypeSafe AI and Jev — a transformer that emits calibrated probabilities and structured judgements instead of text, on the argument that most production uses of a model want a decision and are paying for prose to get one.
why.zh: InstructGPT 的共同作者——正是这项工作把 RLHF 变成了 ChatGPT 背后的对齐方法，也定下了此后所有助手类模型的形态。2024 年离开 OpenAI，2026 年 9 月带着 TypeSafe AI 与 Jev 走出隐身：那是一个不输出文本、而是直接输出校准概率与结构化判断的 Transformer，其论点是——生产环境里对模型的多数调用要的是一个决策，却在为得到它而支付散文的成本。

title.en: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
title.zh: 训练语言模型遵循人类指令

note.en: InstructGPT. Human demonstrations, preference rankings and reinforcement learning, combined into the recipe ChatGPT shipped on eight months later.
note.zh: 即 InstructGPT。人类示范、偏好排序与强化学习三者结合，八个月后 ChatGPT 正是照此配方发布。

title.en: AI Can Write Code. Why Isn’t Software Better?
title.zh: AI Can Write Code. Why Isn’t Software Better?

note.en: Almeida joins a16z's Ben Horowitz and Martin Casado to discuss why AI coding gains haven't translated into better software, drawing on his work at TypeSafe AI.
note.zh: Almeida与a16z的Ben Horowitz和Martin Casado对谈,结合其在TypeSafe AI的工作,探讨为何AI编程能力提升未能带来更好的软件。

title.en: Meta Connect Reactions, Zuck's Beer Pong Controversy, New Bentley EV | Shalev Lifshitz & Romi Lifshitz, Leif Abraham, Diogo Almeida, Hooman Reza Nezhad, Jordan Nanos, Erika Alden DeBenedictis
title.zh: Meta Connect Reactions, Zuck's Beer Pong Controversy, New Bentley EV | Shalev Lifshitz & Romi Lifshitz, Leif Abraham, Diogo Almeida, Hooman Reza Nezhad, Jordan Nanos, Erika Alden DeBenedictis

note.en: Almeida appears as a guest panelist on TBPN discussing Meta Connect reactions, shortly after taking TypeSafe AI's Jev model out of stealth.
note.zh: Almeida作为嘉宾出席TBPN节目讨论Meta Connect相关反应,此前不久他刚将TypeSafe AI的Jev模型公开发布。

title.en: Jev: System One models for Prod, not God — with Diogo Almeida, CEO, TypeSafe AI
title.zh: Jev: System One models for Prod, not God — with Diogo Almeida, CEO, TypeSafe AI

posts.source: Latent Space: The AI Engineer Podcast

note.en: Almeida appeared on the Latent Space podcast to discuss TypeSafe AI's approach of building production-grade 'System One' models rather than chasing AGI.
note.zh: 阿尔梅达做客Latent Space播客，讨论TypeSafe AI打造面向生产环境的"系统一"模型、而非追求通用人工智能的思路。

note.en: Almeida is a co-author of the GPT-4 Technical Report, OpenAI's release paper for its large multimodal model.
note.zh: Almeida是GPT-4技术报告的合著者之一,该报告是OpenAI发布其大型多模态模型的论文。

title.en: A Generalizable Approach to Learning Optimizers
title.zh: A Generalizable Approach to Learning Optimizers

note.en: Almeida co-authors "A Generalizable Approach to Learning Optimizers" with Wojciech Zaremba, proposing a learned optimizer that generalizes to unseen tasks.
note.zh: Almeida与Wojciech Zaremba合著《一种可泛化的学习优化器方法》,提出一种能泛化到未见任务的学习型优化器。

title.en: Diogo Almeida - Deep Learning: Modular in Theory, Inflexible in Practice - TWiML Talk #8
title.zh: Diogo Almeida - Deep Learning: Modular in Theory, Inflexible in Practice - TWiML Talk #8

posts.source: The TWIML AI Podcast (formerly This We…

note.en: Archival TWiML AI interview from when Almeida was a senior data scientist at healthcare startup Enlitic, discussing the limits of modular deep learning.
note.zh: TWiML AI播客旧访谈，阿尔梅达当时任医疗初创公司Enlitic高级数据科学家，谈深度学习模块化方法的局限。

title.en: Genetic Architect: Discovering Genomic Structure with Learned Neural Architectures
title.zh: Genetic Architect: Discovering Genomic Structure with Learned Neural Architectures

note.en: Almeida co-authors "Genetic Architect" with Laura Deming and Sasha Targ, a neural architecture search method for discovering genomic structure, from his time at Enlitic.
note.zh: Almeida与Laura Deming、Sasha Targ合著《Genetic Architect》,提出一种用于发现基因组结构的神经架构搜索方法,发表于其在Enlitic工作期间。

title.en: Resnet in Resnet: Generalizing Residual Architectures
title.zh: Resnet in Resnet: Generalizing Residual Architectures

note.en: Almeida co-authors "Resnet in Resnet," a dual-stream architecture generalizing ResNets, from his time as a deep learning researcher at Enlitic.
note.zh: Almeida合著《Resnet in Resnet》,提出一种泛化ResNet的双流架构,发表于其在Enlitic担任深度学习研究员期间。

title.en: Understanding and Improving Convolutional Neural Networks via Concatenated Rectified Linear Units
title.zh: Understanding and Improving Convolutional Neural Networks via Concatenated Rectified Linear Units

note.en: Almeida co-authors a paper on Concatenated ReLU (CReLU) activations that improve convolutional neural network performance, from his research at Enlitic.
note.zh: Almeida合著论文,提出拼接式ReLU(CReLU)激活函数以提升卷积神经网络性能,发表于其在Enlitic的研究工作期间。

title.en: GradNets: Dynamic Interpolation Between Neural Architectures
title.zh: GradNets: Dynamic Interpolation Between Neural Architectures

note.en: Almeida co-authors "GradNets" with Nate Sauder at Enlitic, a method for dynamically interpolating between neural network architectures during training.
note.zh: Almeida与Nate Sauder在Enlitic合著《GradNets》,提出一种在训练过程中动态插值神经网络架构的方法。

title.en: TypeSafe AI leaves stealth with a $40M seed at a $200M valuation
title.zh: TypeSafe AI 走出隐身，4000 万美元种子轮，估值 2 亿美元

body.en: Led by DCVC. Founded with Erik Gafni and Sasha Sheng to build machine-native models meant to sit inside software as a primitive rather than answer a person in a chat window.
body.zh: 由 DCVC 领投。与 Erik Gafni、Sasha Sheng 共同创立，目标是做「机器原生」模型——作为软件内部的一个原语存在，而不是在对话框里回答人类。

title.en: Jev ships: a frontier model that does not speak
title.zh: Jev 发布：一个不说话的前沿模型

body.en: Trained only on synthetic data, it returns probabilities and confidence over a schema the caller fixes in advance — so there is nothing for it to hallucinate — at sub-100ms latency and up to 100x cheaper than a frontier LLM. Named after William Stanley Jevons.
body.zh: 仅用合成数据训练，返回的是调用方预先固定的结构上的概率与置信度——因而没有可供它幻觉的空间——延迟低于 100 毫秒，成本最多为前沿大模型的百分之一。名字取自经济学家 William Stanley Jevons。

title.en: Jev Founder Diogo Almeida: AI Coding Agents Are Writing the Same Software Faster, Not Better Software
title.zh: Jev Founder Diogo Almeida: AI Coding Agents Are Writing the Same Software Faster, Not Better Software

body.en: Almeida, founder of TypeSafe AI (Jev), argues in an interview that AI coding agents are producing the same software faster rather than better software.
body.zh: TypeSafe AI(Jev)创始人Almeida在采访中表示,AI编程智能体只是让相同的软件写得更快,而非写出更好的软件。

title.en: Diogo Almeida: Why did I make Jev?
title.zh: Diogo Almeida: Why did I make Jev?

body.en: Almeida explained his motivation for building Jev, TypeSafe AI's coding automation product.
body.zh: 阿尔梅达阐述了他打造TypeSafe AI编程自动化产品Jev的初衷。

title.en: TypeSafe's Diogo Almeida: The $1 Trillion Token Surge That Proves 'Code Is the New Consumer'
title.zh: TypeSafe's Diogo Almeida: The $1 Trillion Token Surge That Proves 'Code Is the New Consumer'

body.en: Almeida argued the surge in AI token usage shows 'code is the new consumer,' framing software automation as the next major market.
body.zh: 阿尔梅达认为AI token用量激增表明"代码正成为新的消费者"，将软件自动化视为下一个主要市场。

title.en: Diogo Almeida: Why did I make Jev?
title.zh: Diogo Almeida: Why did I make Jev?

body.en: Almeida explained why he built Jev, TypeSafe AI's fast 'System One' judgment model, in a career-defining interview after leaving OpenAI's RLHF work behind.
body.zh: Almeida在一次专访中解释了他为何打造Jev——TypeSafe AI主打快思考判断的System One模型，标志着他离开OpenAI RLHF工作后的新方向。

title.en: OpenAI Researcher Diogo Almeida Launches New AI Model Jev to Transform Software Automation
title.zh: OpenAI Researcher Diogo Almeida Launches New AI Model Jev to Transform Software Automation

body.en: Almeida launched Jev, TypeSafe AI's new model for software automation, marking his new company's public debut.
body.zh: 阿尔梅达发布Jev——TypeSafe AI面向软件自动化的新模型，标志着他的新公司正式公开亮相。

title.en: Diogo Almeida: The RLHF Co-Author Who Says ChatGPT Was a 'Weird Detour' From Real Automation
title.zh: Diogo Almeida: The RLHF Co-Author Who Says ChatGPT Was a 'Weird Detour' From Real Automation

body.en: Almeida, a co-author of the InstructGPT/RLHF paper, said ChatGPT was a 'weird detour' from the real goal of automating software work.
body.zh: 作为InstructGPT/RLHF论文的共同作者，阿尔梅达表示ChatGPT是通往软件自动化这一真正目标的"奇怪弯路"。
